p: Kaizhi (Shenzhen) Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was founded in 2025 as a joint venture between Innovation New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. (stock code 600361) and Xinzhihua (Shenzhen) Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. The two partners will leverage their respective resources to achieve synergistic development and jointly open a new chapter in the precision manufacturing field. The company is a technology-driven enterprise focused on the machining of high-precision mechanical components. It is located at No. 10 Yumin Road, Shajing Subdistrict, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, and occupies 3,000 square meters, including a standardized temperature-controlled production workshop. Its customers span many fields, including embodied AI robots, industrial robots, and low-altitude drones.
pc: 凯智（深圳）精密制造有限公司成立于2025 年，由创新新材料科技股份有限公司（股票代码600361）与鑫志华（深圳）精密制造有限公司合资组建。双方将依托各自资源优势，实现协同发展，共同开启精密制造领域新布局。企业专注于高精密机械零部件加工的技术型企业。公司坐落于深圳市宝安区沙井街道裕民路10号，占地面积 3000 平方米，拥有标准化恒温生产车间，服务客户覆盖具身智能机器人、工业机器人、低空无人机等多个领域。
